name: Penn-Fudan Database for Pedestrian Detection and Segmentation
description: Penn-Fudan is a classic benchmark for pedestrian detection and instance segmentation. Collected from campus walkways at the University of Pennsylvania and Fudan University, it contains 170 natural images containing 345 pedestrian instances with accurate bounding box and pixel-level instance segmentation annotations.
